remarks: Live the coastal Long Beach lifestyle in this move-in ready, top-floor 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo in the heart of Alamitos Beach, with no one above you. Tucked into a quiet complex of just 8 units on a charming tree-lined stretch of East 3rd Street, this home offers the feel of a boutique building with low HOA dues of only $300 per month. Inside, a beautiful, functional floor plan is filled with natural light and opens to a large private balcony, perfect for morning coffee or the evening ocean breeze.
